units.source_text: 只有二樓食客的那份飯菜，放進托盤端上來；

en.t: Only the second-floor boarder's meal was placed on a tray and carried upstairs;

units.source_text: 比目魚和小夥子則是在樓下四張半榻榻米大的陰溼房間裡匆忙用餐，不時地還能聽到碗碟丁零當啷的碰撞聲。

en.t: Hirame and the boy, meanwhile, hurried through their meal in a damp four-and-a-half-tatami room downstairs, and from time to time I could hear the clatter of bowls and plates knocking together.

units.source_text: 三月末的一個黃昏，比目魚不知是又找到了生財之道，

en.t: One evening toward the end of March, perhaps because Hirame had found some new way of making money,

units.source_text: 還是有了其他妙策（即使這兩點都猜對了，可能還有好幾個我無法猜對的原因吧），

en.t: or because he had come up with some other clever scheme, though even if both guesses were right, there were probably several other reasons I could never have guessed,

units.source_text: 他罕見地把我叫到樓下襬著酒壺的餐桌旁。

en.t: he unusually called me down to the dining table where a sake bottle had been set out.

units.source_text: 請客的主人對著不是比目魚的金槍魚生魚片，感嘆得讚不絕口，還向我這位一臉茫然的食客勸了酒。

en.t: The host, treating me, gazed at the tuna sashimi, not flounder, and praised it with endless admiration, then urged a little sake on me, his bewildered boarder.
What on earth do you intend to do now?
